body.name: exact rational certificate input
body.construction: \(\iota=(T,\alpha,\kappa_-,\kappa_+,\varepsilon)\), together with any mandated \(K\) and \(h\), is encoded by binary integers and signed numerator--denominator pairs in lowest terms; validity requires \(T\ge3\), \(0<\alpha<1/10\), \(0<\kappa_-\le\kappa_+\), \(\varepsilon>0\), and, when supplied, \(K\in\mathbb N_0\) and \(h>0\).
